claim: On September 5, 2025, the FTC voted 3–1 to dismiss both appeals and accede to the vacatur of the Non-Compete Rule.
evidence: On September 5, 2025, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) officially withdrew its notice of appeal in the litigation over the validity of its Non‑compete Clause Rule, thereby abandoning its challenge to the District Court’s ruling invalidating that rule.
excerpt:
FTC Press Release, Sept. 5, 2025, available at https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/09/federal-trade-commission-files-accede-vacatur-non-compete-clause-rule

On September 5, 2025, the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) officially withdrew its notice of appeal in the litigation over the validity of its Non‑compete Clause Rule,1 thereby abandoning its challenge to the District Court’s ruling invalidating that rule.
